semiconductor_relevance: High — YEST Co., Ltd. provides specialized thermal processing equipment crucial for semiconductor wafer processing.
summary: YEST Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on thermal processing solutions. The company offers a range of equipment including furnaces, chillers, and NEOCON systems for semiconductor wafer processing, as well as solutions for OLED and FPD manufacturing.
capabilities: Thermal processing equipment for OLED and FPD manufacturing
